title: Attines
summary: Raleigh names Attines in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Attines, in Annius his Median list, who raigned twentie two yeeres. He was not equated with Artynes. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXV, §. IV, sig. 353a
